scope: Successful account/application retirement transaction changes only the matching cached requester name in durable music queues. Stable tombstone IDs, order, entry IDs, media, unknown fields, revision, head and timestamps remain.

Every later queue write canonicalizes deleted identities under the existing retirement transaction boundary; delayed extraction or an old repeat copy cannot restore a deleted name. Retired actors cannot recreate enqueue receipts.
Current, pending and restored runtime metadata is scrubbed. Public GET/WS snapshots sanitize and serialize under a publication fence; failed identity reads fail closed.
Security cache/socket/voice/permission invalidation runs before any blocking privacy observer. Failed deletion triggers neither security revocation nor retirement observation.

Equal-revision confirmation compares strict semantic JSON with UseNumber and performs no write, preserving object-key-order independence, exact large numbers and unknown fields while rejecting changed arrays/state.
